export interface RequestOptions extends RequestInit {
  timeoutMs?: number;
  maxRetries?: number;
}

export async function resilientFetch<T>(
  url: string,
  options: RequestOptions = {}
): Promise<T> {
  const { timeoutMs = 5000, maxRetries = 3, ...fetchOpts } = options;

  let attempt = 0;
  while (attempt < maxRetries) {
    try {
      const signal = AbortSignal.timeout(timeoutMs);
      const response = await fetch(url, { ...fetchOpts, signal });

      if (!response.ok) {
        if (response.status >= 500 && attempt < maxRetries - 1) {
          throw new Error(`Server error: ${response.status}`);
        }
        throw new Error(`HTTP ${response.status}: ${response.statusText}`);
      }
      return (await response.json()) as T;
    } catch (err) {
      attempt++;
      if (attempt >= maxRetries) throw err;
      const delay = Math.pow(2, attempt) * 100 + Math.random() * 50;
      await new Promise(r => setTimeout(r, delay));
    }
  }
  throw new Error('Unreachable fetch failure');
}

func WorkerPool(ctx context.Context, numWorkers int, jobs []Job) ([]Result, error) {
    jobsCh := make(chan Job, len(jobs))
    resultsCh := make(chan Result, len(jobs))
    var wg sync.WaitGroup

    for w := 0; w < numWorkers; w++ {

import java.util.concurrent.*;
import java.util.function.Consumer;
import java.util.List;

public class AsyncEventDispatcher<T> {
    private final List<Consumer<T>> listeners = new CopyOnWriteArrayList<>();
    private final ExecutorService executor;

    public AsyncEventDispatcher(ExecutorService executor) {
        this.executor = executor;
    }

    public void register(Consumer<T> listener) {
        listeners.add(listener);
    }

    public CompletableFuture<Void> dispatch(T event) {
        List<CompletableFuture<Void>> futures = listeners.stream()
            .map(listener -> CompletableFuture.runAsync(() -> {
                try {
                    listener.accept(event);
                } catch (Throwable t) {
                    System.err.println("Listener error: " + t.getMessage());
                }
            }, executor))
            .toList();
        return CompletableFuture.allOf(futures.toArray(new CompletableFuture[0]));
    }
}

use std::sync::{mpsc, Arc, Mutex};
use std::thread;

type Job = Box<dyn FnOnce() + Send + 'static>;

enum Message {
    NewJob(Job),
    Terminate,
}

pub struct ThreadPool {
    workers: Vec<Worker>,
    sender: Option<mpsc::Sender<Message>>,
}

struct Worker {
    id: usize,
    thread: Option<thread::JoinHandle<()>>,
}

impl ThreadPool {
    pub fn new(size: usize) -> ThreadPool {
        assert!(size > 0);
        let (sender, receiver) = mpsc::channel();
        let receiver = Arc::new(Mutex::new(receiver));
        let mut workers = Vec::with_capacity(size);
        for id in 0..size {
            workers.push(Worker::new(id, Arc::clone(&receiver)));
        }
        ThreadPool { workers, sender: Some(sender) }
    }

    pub fn execute<F>(&self, f: F)
    where
        F: FnOnce() + Send + 'static,
    {
        let job = Box::new(f);
        self.sender.as_ref().unwrap().send(Message::NewJob(job)).unwrap();
    }
}

impl Worker {
    fn new(id: usize, receiver: Arc<Mutex<mpsc::Receiver<Message>>>) -> Worker {
        let thread = thread::spawn(move || loop {
            let message = receiver.lock().unwrap().recv().unwrap();
            match message {
                Message::NewJob(job) => job(),
                Message::Terminate => break,
            }
        });
        Worker { id, thread: Some(thread) }
    }
}

impl Drop for ThreadPool {
    fn drop(&mut self) {
        drop(self.sender.take());
        for worker in &mut self.workers {
            if let Some(thread) = worker.thread.take() {
                thread.join().unwrap();
            }
        }
    }
}
